name: tip_adapter
description: Training-free Tip-Adapter on TITAN (CONCH v1.5) slide embeddings: few-shot class-balanced cache affinity combined at equal weight (per-fold z-scored) with the zero-shot MSI/MSS text delta. Secondary CoOp-lite variant learns a logistic head on the two prompt-channel cosines. Few-shot curve K∈{1,2,4,8,16,all}.
